note: Birnbaum et al. (2024) identified 13 affected individuals across 8 Ashkenazi Jewish families carrying the identical homozygous frameshift founder variant in SGSM3.

evidence.text: Birnbaum et al. identified 13 patients across 8 distinct families of Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry who all carried the identical homozygous frameshift founder variant in the SGSM3 gene.

source.title: Intellectual disability syndrome associated with a homozygous founder variant in SGSM3 in Ashkenazi Jews
source.quote: 8 families of Ashkenazi Jewish origin who all carried the same homozygous frameshift variant in SGSM3
